answer.reason: Belgium's population aged 15-64 is approximately 63.56% of the total population, which aligns with known World Bank demographic data for 2023. The other option (about 59.84%) is too low for Belgium's age structure.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Population ages 15-64 (% of total population)', what value is listed for Belgium (BEL) in 2023?

A. 59.8437111172079%
B. 63.5639803078539%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population ages 15-64 (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.1564.TO.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)
